Title: GUID migration: Storage Managed Disks, US Government regions

Body.Content:
Currently, premium Managed Disks are denoted “Premium Storage - Page Blob” on your bill. Effective July 1, 2018, premium Managed Disks customers will be migrated to new resource GUIDs. “Premium Storage - Page Blob” will be migrated to the “Premium Managed Disks” resource GUIDs. All other disk characteristics (for example, pricing, regional availability, and capabilities) will remain the same.

There won’t be a pricing impact from this change, but you will need to modify billing routines that rely on names or resource GUIDs. See the following table for GUID migration details.
